purpose: Reconstruct a common no-lookahead B02 M15 open-path feature contract across 2023 and both historical 2024 halves, then identify admission states whose baseline outcomes are negative in every development period before any candidate evaluation.

features: side-aligned M15 open move over 15m, 30m, 1h and 4h
open range and total path length
entry executable distance outside the B02 session range
side, entry hour and pre-entry exposure state

negative_all_period_fixed_rules.rule: B02 short and side-aligned 4h M15-open move <= 20 pips

interpretation.mechanism: B02 short breakouts entered without an established side-aligned four-hour downward open-path are weak-trend or counter-regime admissions.
interpretation.direction_asymmetry: Short direction alone is not consistently negative because 2024 H2 shorts are positive; the weakness appears only when short direction and insufficient four-hour alignment coincide.

reviewed: R1 generic momentum, trend and ATR directional-change candidate universe
duplicate_research_audit.distinct_information: This does not introduce a new generic trend-following signal or reopen the R1 universe. It conditions the accepted B02 short session-range breakout on its own pre-entry four-hour side-aligned open path under the current historical MT4 lineage.
